blocks.title: Debugging aur bugs
blocks.text: Debugging bugs dhoondne aur theek karne ka amal hai, yaani software ki woh ghaltiyan jo use ghair mutawaqqo rawayya dilati hain. Bug pehchanne ka matlab software ka rawayya dekh kar masle ki jarr dhoondna hai; use hal karne ka matlab ghalti theek karne ke liye code badalna hai.

items: Debuggers: software tools jo programmers ko code qadam ba qadam chalane, variables dekhne aur program ka chalna nigrani mein rakhne dete hain.
Print statements: program ke mukhtalif maqamat par variables ki qeematein print karna.
Code reviews: doosre developers aap ka code parh kar mumkina ghaltiyan pakarte hain.

blocks.text: Debugging ka naam 1947 ke ek waqiye se para jab computer mein ek asli keera (bug), patanga (moth), mila (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Debugging ke teen tools ya tareeqe bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Debuggers (code qadam ba qadam chalana aur variables dekhna), print statements (variables ki qeematein dikhana) aur code reviews (doosron ka code parhna).

items: Debugging: bugs dhoondna aur theek karna; rawayya dekh kar pehchanna, code badal kar hal.
Tools aur tareeqe: debuggers, print statements, code reviews; naam 1947 mein mile patange se.
